Rumours of giant krakens, infernal maelstroms, huge sea serpents and hostile deserted islands abound, and only skeletal shipwrecks remain as testament to tentative past expeditions. It is time to arm yourselves with the latest instruments of navigation and prepare to set sail on your most daring expedition yet, knowing that if you succeed, the glory will be beyond your wildest dreams and your map will become the stuff of legends. Forge your own legend by charting your exploits in the terrifying and hostile Lost Seas. Only the most perilous and daring journey will go down in history. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Gameplay Place tiles in a 4x4 grid according to the goals per column and row. At the start, choose between the front and back side of each goal card. The potential points are shown in the flag at the top left corner. Symbols There are 6 different symbol types: Kraken (Red Squid) Leviathan (Green Sea Monster) Maelstrom (Lightning Bolt) Rock Sandbank (Palm Tree) Shipwreck Notes Read the goals carefully. Many require an exact number of a particular symbol. The last player in the previous round is the first player in the next round. (So in a 2-person game, after the first round, you will be playing 2 turns in a row -- be careful what you discard!) If there is a tie, the winner is the player who has achieved the most goals. If there is still a tie, the winner is the player who fulfilled the goal tile worth the most points. If there is still a tie, the players share the victory. I think I'd always prefer Sagrada over this, which gives me a similar drafting/array building vibe but more fun.
